categories.main_business_segments: The company operates through four strategic business divisions: Plasticizer, Synthetic Resin, Household Chemicals, and Bio & Energy. These segments cover products such as anhydrous phthalic acid, plasticizers, lubricating oils, unsaturated polyester resins, coating resins, surfactants, refined glycerin, biodiesel, bio-heavy oil, and hard carbon. Additionally, the company has subsidiaries engaged in manufacturing, trade, and service sectors including paints and leisure services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes chemical synthesis technologies based on petrochemical feedstocks like naphtha and natural gas to produce various resins and chemical intermediates. It employs advanced manufacturing processes for environmentally friendly and high-performance products, including bio-based raw materials, recycling of plastic waste for eco-friendly plasticizers, and proprietary methods for producing isocyanate curing agents and polyurethane systems. Research and development focus on non-phthalate plasticizers, bio-based surfactants, and innovative coating resins with low VOC emissions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include paint manufacturers, coating companies, PVC processing firms, construction material producers, automotive and electronics industries, and personal care product manufacturers. The company serves both domestic and international markets, supplying raw materials and intermediates for diverse industrial applications such as construction, automotive, electronics, textiles, and consumer goods. Its biofuels are supplied mainly to refineries and power generation companies through competitive bidding.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with production facilities in Ulsan, Cheongyang, and Jeonju. It has subsidiaries and trade offices in China (Yingpa, Shanghai), Hong Kong, Vietnam (Hanoi), and India, enabling it to serve global markets. Sales are conducted domestically and internationally through direct sales, branch offices, and distributors.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the petrochemical supply chain. It manufactures chemical intermediates such as anhydrous phthalic acid and plasticizers, synthetic resins, and finished chemical products like surfactants and biofuels. It supplies these products to downstream manufacturers and end-users in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding eco-friendly product lines, such as non-phthalate plasticizers, bio-based surfactants, and sustainable coating resins. R&D efforts focus on developing high-performance, low-emission materials, biofuels, and advanced polymers for emerging applications like electric vehicles and renewable energy storage. The company invests in proprietary technologies for isocyanate synthesis, 3D printing resins, and environmentally compliant chemical processes, aiming to enhance competitiveness and respond to future market trends.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of chemical products and intermediates across its four business segments. Sales channels include direct sales to industrial customers, branch offices, and distributors. The company also earns revenue from its subsidiaries engaged in manufacturing and service sectors. Pricing is influenced by raw material costs and market supply-demand dynamics.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading domestic position in several product categories, including the number one market share in isocyanate curing agents and anion surfactants like LAS. It competes with multinational corporations in synthetic resins and specialty chemicals. Its plasticizer production capacity is significant domestically, sharing the market with OCI. The company emphasizes technological innovation and eco-friendly product development to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of the end of 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately KRW 1.79 trillion, with a total asset base of KRW 1.31 trillion and equity of KRW 736 billion. The company experienced a revenue decline of 17.6% compared to the previous year, attributed to global demand slowdown and petrochemical market conditions. It maintains a production capacity of over 1.26 million tons with a utilization rate around 60.8%. R&D expenditure accounted for about 1.2% of sales, reflecting ongoing investment in innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its focus on eco-friendly and high-performance chemical products, including pioneering recycled plastic-based plasticizers and bio-based surfactants. It offers a broad product portfolio with strong domestic market leadership in key segments and proprietary technologies for advanced materials. Its commitment to sustainability, regulatory compliance, and continuous R&D enables it to meet evolving customer needs and environmental standards, providing competitive advantages in both domestic and global markets.
